newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Herman Miller plans South America growth.
newsitem.headline: Herman Miller plans South America growth.

text.p: U.S. office furniture manufacturer Herman Miller Inc plans to substantially increase its presence in South America, where it sees great potential for growth, chairman David Nelson said Wednesday.
"We want to increase our market share in South America, in particular in Venezuela, Colombia, Argentina and Brazil," he told a news conference in Caracas.
Without going into details, Nelson explained to Reuters that "There is room for optimism throughout South America. In every country, investment is increasing."

He said office furniture in the United States represents a $9-billion market and "in South America the market at his point would be in the order of a billion, so if we're doing 100 million ... that would sort of make sense."
